name: apple-app-quality
description: Apple app quality gate for Codex — structured review, SwiftUI refactoring, deep audit analysis, and official Xcode MCP-backed test workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Review, refactor, and test Apple app changes
interface.longDescription: Covers Phase 5 and Phase 6 work: code review, view refactoring, deep audit context building, and official Xcode MCP-backed test discovery, targeted test execution, build-log inspection, and preview-oriented verification for Apple app changes.
defaultPrompt: Review this SwiftUI change for architecture, code quality, tests, and performance.
Refactor a SwiftUI view without changing behavior, then confirm the change with the right preview or test strategy.
Add or improve Apple-platform tests and run the smallest relevant Xcode test slice through the official Xcode MCP bridge.
